mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, u.username AS updated_by_username FROM parameters p LEFT JOIN users u ON p.updated_by = u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO parameters (param_key, param_value, description, updated_by) VALUES (#{paramKey}, #{paramValue}, #{description}, #{updatedBy})

INSERT INTO parameters (param_key, param_value, description, updated_by) VALUES (#{paramKey}, #{paramValue}, #{description}, #{updatedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE param_value = VALUES(param_value), description = VALUES(description), updated_by = VALUES(updated_by)
